column1: # Connectives: words that join the parts of a name and carry nothing into it.
# Section 14: a compound name is the words that name the thing, in English
# order. A word that only relates one part to another — "with", "being",
# "such that", "permissibly" — says what the order of the parts already says,
# so it is dropped: الوَقْف الجَائِز مَعَ كَوْنِ الوَصْل أَوْلَى is waqf_jaiz_wasl_awla.
# A row is matched by its letters, whatever its vocalization, so the case
# ending of كَوْن (كَوْنِ, كَوْنُ) needs no row of its own.
